svg.title: NinaPro DB2 paired windows and participant independent splits
svg.desc: Editable five-band scientific cohort diagram based on recorded 40-person E1 window selection and participant splitting. The crop and waveform shapes are schematic, not an additional filtering procedure.

g.text: NINAPRO DB2: PAIRED WINDOWS AND PARTICIPANT SPLITS
Forty E1 participants · Aligned 300-ms windows · Person-independent evaluation design
Signal crop is schematic; 337,853 eligible windows were reduced to 40,000 before model fitting.
Source E1 arrays → label-pure paired windows → selected cohort → modal features → independent participant roles
